name: Apothecary Mortar and Pestle
description:
A rough inner bowl and rounded pestle grind dried materials into a consistent powder. They grant no proficiency and do not replace a complete tool kit.

Sold as one small ceramic mortar and pestle.

name: Alchemist's Supplies
description:
A travelling case holds small mixing vessels, a mortar and pestle, stirring implements and handling tools. The fitted case keeps the fragile pieces separate.

The native tool check supports alchemical work when the GM calls for it. Proficiency, recipes, ingredients, fuel and a suitable workspace are separate; owning the kit does not permit automatic potion crafting.
saleUnit: One portable alchemist tool kit and fitted case

weight.notes: 80% of the 2014 eight-pound tool-kit baseline; includes its carrying case.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
